verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents role-based access scoped down to the table and column level, with SSO through your own identity provider. That covers roles plus table- and column-level control. The evidence never mentions row-level policies or data masking, which are half of what the story asks for. Missing for 10: row-level security policies, column masking policies, in-depth access-control documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
